criteria.rationale: Distinguishes true banking providers from fintechs that only offer payments, wallets, or non-deposit services without deposit insurance.
Separates peers that provide programmable or immediate-use card capabilities favored by startups from firms that lack card products.
Identifies companies that support in-person spending and traditional card issuance, a common feature for full-service business banks.

criteria.text: Supports domestic and international wire transfers
criteria.rationale: Differentiates banks that enable traditional bank transfers and cross-border payments from fintechs limited to ACH or card rails.

criteria.text: Provides currency exchange or multi-currency account functionality
criteria.rationale: Separates firms that serve startups operating internationally or handling multiple currencies from those offering only single-currency accounts.

criteria.text: Markets or offers business banking services specifically targeted at startups and founders
criteria.rationale: Encodes the user's intent by distinguishing banks whose primary customer segment is startups from general-purpose or consumer-focused banks.
